subject.title: feat(sandbox): add skipSkillsSync config option to suppress skill sync

question: Should preinstalled sandbox skills use a backend-declared materialization/root capability, or should OpenClaw support the new `agents.*.sandbox.skipSkillsSync` public config contract?
rationale: The safe repair depends on who owns the destination and prompt paths; implementation review cannot choose between a general operator switch and backend-specific guarantees.

options.title: Backend capability
options.body: Have the sandbox backend declare its sandbox-visible skill root or completed materialization so core avoids copying without deleting backend-owned files.

options.title: Public config with root
options.body: Keep the config but require an explicit sandbox skill root, separate OpenClaw-owned cleanup, and repeated-use compatibility proof.

options.title: Keep automatic sync
options.body: Decline the additional contract and retain automatic materialization as the only supported path.

recommendation.title: Backend capability
recommendation.body: Have the sandbox backend declare its sandbox-visible skill root or completed materialization so core avoids copying without deleting backend-owned files.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged pluggable-backend work makes them the strongest available owner for deciding core config versus backend capability.
